data.name: Plants
data.abstract: Data has been extracted from the USDA plants database. It contains all plants (species and genera) in the database and the states of USA and Canada where they occur.

additional_info.summary: The data is in the transactional form. It contains the Latin names (species or genus) and state abbreviations.
additional_info.variable_info: Each row contains a Latin name (species or genus) and a list of state abbreviations.
